evidence.summary: [HordeSiege] System START -- online (4 waves configured); Sentry deployed (HP 500); Wave 1/4 'Vanguard' STARTING 3 enemies -> spawned on ring -> all down -> CLEARED -> Intermission; Wave 2/4 'Raiders' 4 enemies -> CLEARED; Wave 3/4 'Warband' 5 enemies -> CLEARED; Wave 4/4 'Warlord' boss 1 enemy -> down -> CLEARED; 'All waves cleared -- VICTORY!'. No runtime errors mentioning HordeSiegeRoundLoop.

reasons: System STARTS: '[HordeSiege] System START' + Sentry deployed logged at boot
SPAWNS observable: all 4 waves spawned enemies on the spawnRing (radius 34) with logged coordinates

PROGRESSES at PLAYER level: enemies cleared by the defending Sentry combatant (attackDamage 30 / reach 14 / cooldown 0.6 per config), each wave CLEARED with intermission transitions, boss wave included
Reaches VICTORY: 'All waves cleared -- VICTORY!' with no auto-kill hook and no error mentioning the artifact

steps: Author config-driven wave lifecycle: CONFIG.Waves table (count/health/boss), spawn ring, InterWaveDelay
Spawn enemies on a ring around Center; each has Humanoid + Died detector setting alive=false
Deploy a defending Sentry combatant with its own attack loop (reach/cooldown/damage) as the player-level damage source
Wave-cleared = all wave enemies dead; VICTORY logged after the final boss wave; all events print with [HordeSiege] tag

recipe.text: Server Script implementing a RoundLoop-style horde/wave lifecycle. Config table drives 4 escalating waves (3 normal + boss finale). Enemies spawn on a 34-stud ring and advance toward the keep; they die ONLY from the Sentry combatant's own attack loop (a real fighter that finds the nearest enemy, faces it, and TakeDamage on a cooldown when in reach) -- the lifecycle merely detects Humanoid.Died to count wave clears, never auto-killing. Prints every lifecycle event (system start, wave start, each spawn, each kill, wave cleared, VICTORY) with a [HordeSiege] tag for VERIFY to observe. No auto-kill/test hook.
